mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id=rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id=#{roleId} AND rm.deleted=FALSE ORDER BY m.sort_order,m.id

SELECT DISTINCT rm.menu_id FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.deleted=FALSE AND r.status='ENABLED' JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id AND rm.deleted=FALSE WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role_menu SET deleted=TRUE WHERE role_id=#{roleId} AND menu_id=#{menuId} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE sys_role SET version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE id=#{roleId} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=FALSE
